messages.content: Sending that to your phone now.

function.name: voice_followup_send_links
function.description: Text the caller a link so they can handle things themselves instead of staying on the phone. PROACTIVELY OFFER this once you've found their job: 'Want me to text you a link where you can check status, send a photo of the model sticker and a quick video of the problem, or reschedule?' Call it after they say yes. Needs the job_id from lookup_customer_by_phone or lookup_by_claim_number. The customer-SMS gate still applies.

job_id.description: The job id from a prior lookup (open_jobs[].id or primary.job_id).

offer_kind.description: portal_and_uploads = full portal + invite photo/video (default); status = just status link; reschedule = reschedule link.
